symptom: There is a bug with the Equil pump integration: it is not possible to set or change the pump profile. Each time a profile change is attempted, AndroidAPS runs into a pump connection problem and the operation fails. The profile is not updated on the pump.
cause: The code was observing max bolus instead of max basal, causing profile changes with basal rates higher than 1.5 U/h to fail.
fix: The bug was fixed by a commit that will be part of AAPS v4. As a workaround, increase max bolus to 2.5U.
evidence_quote: fixed by https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/e4e21002782c75b21438086e9b220bcb6f030bb5 It will be part of AAPS v4 So far increase max bolus to 2.5U as a workaround
